inspiration.title: Out of ideas?
inspiration.description: Kadex turns a creative itch into a concrete challenge with constraints made to spark action.

generator.title: Choose a generator
generator.description: Start with the kind of generator you want to use: writing, music, video, games, photography, cooking, and more.

constraints.title: Build your challenge
constraints.description: Pick categories, adjust the difficulty, then generate a constraint set that gives your creation a clear direction.

publish.title: Save, create, publish
publish.description: Keep the constraint sets that inspire you. Once your creation is done, publish the result.

customize.title: Create your own rules
customize.description: Make custom generators, add categories, share them with the community, and discover what other creators build.
